Header.title: Mesfiney's Love Foundation
Header.subtitle: Supporting children with special needs in Eritrea

home.heroDescription: Founded in memory of Mesfin Hiruy, we provide healthcare support, education, and play for children with special needs. Because every child deserves a chance to thrive, learn, and smile.
home.missionBody1: Mesfin Hiruy was born on 7 December 1990. From the age of two, he bravely battled Leukaemia until his passing on 4 December 2000. His mother, Nebiat Yoseph, founded this charity in his memory to help children in Eritrea with special needs.
home.missionBody2: We believe that children with disabilities deserve the same access to play, education, and joyful experiences as every other child.
home.ctaDescription: Whether you donate, volunteer, or simply spread the word, your support changes lives. Join us in supporting children with special needs in Eritrea.
home.memorialSummary: Founded by his mother, Nebiat Yoseph, to bring play, education, and dignity to children with special needs.
home.stat1Desc: Every pound goes directly to projects on the ground in Eritrea
home.stat2Desc: Supporting children with autism, Down syndrome & hearing loss
home.stat3Desc: Hospital playrooms, playgrounds, assistive aid & school laptops
home.stat4Desc: Serving communities since 2010 under Charity No. 1139089

about.pageSubtitle: Founded in memory of Mesfin Hiruy, a brave young boy who inspired a movement of compassion.
about.originBody1: Mesfin Hiruy was born on 7 December 1990. From the age of two, he bravely battled Leukaemia until his passing on 4 December 2000. His mother, Nebiat Yoseph, founded this charity in his memory to help children in Eritrea with special needs.
about.quote1: We believe that children with disabilities deserve the same access to play, education, and joyful experiences as every other child.
about.missionSubtitle: The three charitable objects that guide everything we do.
about.healthDesc: To promote the physical and mental wellbeing of children with special needs in Eritrea.
about.educationDesc: To promote the education of target group by providing equipment and facilities.
about.reliefDesc: Relief of poverty of target group.
about.governanceBody: Mesfiney's Love Foundation is governed by a Board of Trustees in accordance with its constitution. The charity was formally established through the adoption of its constitution on 4 July 2008 and is registered with the Charity Commission for England and Wales under charity number 1139089.
